zone.description: casjay-base default zone. Wide open by design: firewalld's job here is only to serve as fail2ban's backend (banaction = firewallcmd-ipset in etc/fail2ban/jail.d/00-firewalld.conf) - fail2ban's own dynamic ipset/rich-rule bans still apply on top of an ACCEPT target, so misbehaving IPs still get blocked. A restrictive allow-list here previously broke real services (mail, dns, ftp, rsync, dovecot, docker, incus, mosh) every time it fell out of sync with what was actually running, and required manually resetting firewalld after every restart. Do not reintroduce a per-service allow-list - if a zone-level block is ever needed again, add it deliberately and keep it in sync with every service that binds a public port.
